mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag_group (name, kind, scope, lora_id, category, note, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{kind}, #{scope}, #{loraId}, #{category}, #{note}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE tag_group SET name = #{name}, kind = #{kind}, scope = #{scope}, lora_id = #{loraId}, category = #{category}, note = #{note}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.group_id AS groupId, r.ref_group_id AS refGroupId, r.priority, r.sort_order AS sortOrder, g.name AS refGroupName, g.scope AS refScope, l.name AS refLoraName, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_group_item i WHERE i.group_id = r.ref_group_id), 0) AS refItemCount FROM group_ref r JOIN tag_group g ON g.id = r.ref_group_id LEFT JOIN lora l ON l.id = g.lora_id WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY r.priority, r.sort_order, r.id
